adapterContract.notes: Provider profiles map their own column vocabulary onto these canonical fields. Silver canonicalization reads the field map rather than provider-specific column names, so Lakehouse entities are not coupled to any single archive's schema.

deterministic-obscore-fixture.label: Deterministic ObsCore Fixture
deterministic-obscore-fixture.notes: Built-in bounded records used by the local PR41 runner and CI-safe MVP tests.

eso-obscore-core-proof.label: ESO TAP ObsCore Core Proof
eso-obscore-core-proof.query: SELECT TOP 5 obs_publisher_did, obs_collection, dataproduct_type, s_ra, s_dec, access_url FROM ivoa.ObsCore
eso-obscore-core-proof.notes: PR40 public-source proof profile. PR41 runs it from a checked-in offline fixture so the MVP stays CI-safe; the endpoint/query are recorded as the contract this fixture is shaped after, not as evidence of a live PR41 query.

nrao-vlass-development.label: NRAO VLASS Development Fixture
nrao-vlass-development.query: SELECT TOP 5 product_id, collection_name, product_type, ra_deg, dec_deg, download_url FROM vlass.quicklook_products
nrao-vlass-development.notes: Radio-astronomy-aligned profile that validates the adapter contract against a non-ObsCore column vocabulary. Backed by a checked-in offline fixture; it is not a live NRAO/VLASS extract.

nrao-tap-live.label: NRAO TAP Live Extract
nrao-tap-live.query: SELECT TOP 5 product_id, collection_name, product_type, ra_deg, dec_deg, download_url FROM vlass.quicklook_products
nrao-tap-live.notes: Live radio-astronomy extract requiring network access and a validated query contract. Intentionally inactive: PR41 does not perform live source queries, so this profile has no adapter fixture and is excluded from every active bundle.

live-default.label: Live Default
live-default.intendedUse: Default PR41 bundle. The ESO profile queries live on a developer machine and falls back to its fixture in CI. The deterministic fixture is always included so the quarantine, duplicate, and invalid-coordinate contracts stay provable regardless of what a live archive returns.

offline-fixture.label: Offline Fixture
offline-fixture.intendedUse: Fully offline PR41 source bundle for runs that must never touch the network.

core-proof.label: Core Public Proof
core-proof.intendedUse: Bounded ESO-shaped profile inherited from PR40 proof work, run offline in PR41.

expanded-development.label: Expanded Development
expanded-development.intendedUse: Multi-provider bundle that validates the adapter contract across ObsCore and NRAO column vocabularies without activating live-network profiles.
